text:
Briana: Heads-up — we need a plan to backfill the v4->v5 payload contract for Search API consumers before we flip the deprecation flag. Some customers still send `query_text` and `filters` as top-level fields; v5 expects `input.text` and `input.filterSets`.
Sam: Ack. Do we want a runtime shim (proxy) or a one-time ingestion backfill + client opt-in?
Maya: Runtime shim is fastest for customers but it adds latency and more paths to test. Backfill avoids runtime cost but needs DB migration and might miss ephemeral clients.
Benji: Can we do hybrid? Start with a lightweight proxy that rewrites incoming v4 shapes to v5, collect telemetry for 2w, then run a backfill for tenants that opt-out.
Briana: Hybrid sounds good. Key questions: observability, error surface, and rollout/cohorts. Also need to limit scope to Search only — keep blast radius small.
Sam: For observability: emit `compat.rewrite.v4_to_v5` counter + `compat.rewrite.latency_ms` histograms. Tag by tenant and route. If rewrite fails, 415 and increment `compat.failure`.
Maya: Agree. Also log original payload to GCS for 7 days behind a flag so we can debug bad rewrites.
Benji: Implementation options: 1) edge proxy (nginx/lua), 2) service-side adapter in gateway (Go), 3) sidecar shim per runtime.
Sam: Pros/cons quick take: edge proxy = fastest rollout, harder to test complex rewrites. Gateway adapter = central, easier telemetry and feature flags. Sidecar = most isolated but operational overhead.
Briana: I'm leaning gateway adapter. We already have feature-flag hooks and rollout infra there. Ops SRE: any concerns about added CPU on gateway?
Ops SRE: Add a path-specific CPU budget. If we do gateway, limit rewrites to a single thread pool. Also add QPS-based sampling to avoid hot tenants blowing up.
Maya: For the actual rewrite logic, propose a small deterministic transformer with unit tests and a property-test harness. Example pseudo-snippet:
```
// transform v4 -> v5
if (payload.query_text) {
  payload.input = payload.input || {}
  payload.input.text = payload.query_text
  delete payload.query_text
}
if (payload.filters) {
  payload.input = payload.input || {}
  payload.input.filterSets = normalizeFilters(payload.filters)
  delete payload.filters
}
```
Benji: Nice. Add strict validation after transform. If validation fails and tenant is in "fail-open" cohort, log and pass through; otherwise reject.
Sam: Rollout plan draft:
- Phase 0: internal shadow mode for 48h (gateway runs transform in shadow, emits diffs).
- Phase 1: opt-in cohort (5 tenants) with rewrites enabled for real traffic, 1w watch.
- Phase 2: expand to 50% of legacy traffic with sampling, 2w watch + backfill prep.
- Phase 3: run backfill for tenants that remain on v4 and offer migration docs/SDKs.
- Phase 4: flip deprecation flag, 30d notice then enforcement.
Briana: Sounds reasonable. Who takes ownership for the backfill job and migration docs?
Maya: I'll own the backfill job code. Benji can own the gateway adapter. Sam can draft the migration guide and SDK snippets.
Benji: I can prototype adapter by EOD tomorrow. Quick question: do we persist a tenant-level migration status in config store?
Sam: Yes — add `tenant_migration_status` enum: `legacy`, `shadow`, `rewriting`, `backfilled`, `migrated`. Expose via admin API and console.
Ops SRE: We need runbook entries: how to disable rewrites, how to hotfix mapping rules, and how to drain the transform pool.
Briana: Add a safety cutover flag `compat.disable_all_rewrites` controlled by execs + oncall.
Maya: For backfill, we'll create a idempotent job that reads historical requests (7d window) and writes v5-shaped records to the new ingestion path. We'll mark progress per-tenant and support resume.
Benji: Testing: unit + integration + a small e2e against canary environment. Also exercise error paths with malformed filters.
Sam: Docs/sdks: include code examples for both node and python. Note: warn about semantic changes in filterSets ordering — that can affect scoring.
Briana: Meeting ask: can Benji and Maya sync for 30m tomorrow to align on transform semantics and backfill contract?
Benji: Yes. 10am PT works.
Maya: Confirmed.
deploy-bot: deploy started: gateway/adapter/feature-flagging v2 -> canary (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:
Briana: :thumbsup: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after shadow run metrics.
Sam: I'll open the migration guide PR now and link it here. :eyes:
Ops SRE: I'll add runbook draft and alert rules for `compat.failure > 0.1%` and `compat.rewrite.latency_ms P95 > 200ms`.
Briana: Great. Closing loop — plan and owners captured.
